attributes.description:
Tired of waking up and forgetting those amazing, bizarre, or insightful dreams? Dream AI is the ultimate dream journal, designed to help you capture, understand, and analyse your dreams like never before.

Here's how it works:

Speak Your Dreams, We'll Do the Rest: Our advanced voice recording automatically transcribes your dreams, making journaling effortless, even when you're half-asleep.

Get to the Heart of Your Dreams: Our powerful AI analyses your entries and provides concise summaries, revealing the core themes and emotions hidden within.

A Beautiful Space for Reflection: Enjoy a beautifully designed app that's a joy to use. Organize your dreams, search your archive, and track your journey of self-discovery.
Key Features:

Effortless voice recording (speech-to-text)
Manual text entry option AI-powered dream summarization Searchable dream archive
Download Dream AI now and start unlocking the secrets of your dreams!

Subscription Options:
Enhance your Dream Journal abilities with our premium features:
Weekly subscription
Annual subscription

Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple ID account settings.


Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Privacy policy: https://faith-tech.io/privacy-policy
